_about: MCP servers the engine needs to push, drawn from salon's catalog (~/.claude/plugins/cache/atelier/salon/0.1.1/mcp-configs/mcp-servers.json). None is enabled yet. Merge the entry you choose into .mcp.json with /salon:mcp-setup <key>, seed its key as a keychain item (service brand.keychain_service from engine.json, account = the env var name) and add that name to the --export list in scripts/cycle.sh - no token goes in .claude/settings.local.json - and the distributor agent can hand teasers to it. The Apify LinkedIn listening server was moved out of .mcp.json on 2026-11-05 so a plain `claude` needs no environment variable; it is the first entry below, for in-session use only (listen.py --linkedin reaches the same actors over REST through secrets.py).

typefully._why: Drafts and schedules X + LinkedIn from one place; drafts stay reviewable before they go. Fits the manual-release rule best.

buffer._why: Official remote MCP, queue-based scheduling for X and LinkedIn company pages.

postiz._why: Open-source scheduler with an official remote MCP; self-hostable on the sovereign tooling the deck asks for (Principles s5: Proton workspace).

x-api._why: Official X MCP via xurl OAuth bridge, for reading replies and mentions on our own handle (reply-playbook, engagement-monitor). Posting needs the pay-per-use Production plan.
x-api._flag: COST: X dev app on the Pay-per-use plan

website._why: Not an MCP. The site reads the published-posts feed (GET /api/published on the control page, or engine.py export-published); marking an article live there POSTs the site's rebuild webhook with the webhook secret. publish.py --webhook does the same POST when <env_prefix>WEBHOOK_SECRET is set.
website.post_url: engine.json params.site.post_url, with {slug} filled per Blog row
website.agentic_channel: a /llms.txt on the site that lists every published insight is the agentic channel family project.md may name

avoid.linkedin-unofficial: ToS-flagged scraper with browser login. Salon requires explicit confirmation to add. Do not use for an institutional handle.

apify-social-listening._why: LinkedIn keyword, company and profile listening through three pinned harvestapi actors, in-session only. Pay-per-result. Add to .mcp.json or .claude/settings.local.json when wanted; export APIFY_TOKEN first (secrets.py --export APIFY_TOKEN).
